## Yosuke Kimura

Associate Professor, Department of Industrial Engineering and Economics,
School of Engineering, Institute of Science Tokyo

木村遥介（きむら ようすけ）／ 東京科学大学 工学院 経営工学系 准教授

I am an Associate Professor in the
[Inoue–Kimura Laboratory](http://www.me.titech.ac.jp/~inouelab/) at the
[Institute of Science Tokyo](https://www.isct.ac.jp/en). I obtained my Ph.D. in Economics
from the University of Tokyo in 2017. I am also a visiting researcher at the Policy Research
Institute, Ministry of Finance, Japan.

### Research Interests

Corporate Finance · Firm Dynamics · Innovation · Networks · Information ·
Asset Pricing · Macroeconomics

::: {.callout-note}
## Prospective graduate students
I welcome inquiries from prospective graduate students through the International Graduate
Program (IGP). If your interests align with my research, please read the
[guidance for applicants](igp.html) before contacting me.
:::
